_comment: Live Fabric Apps Gallery post URLs, filled in as each submission goes out.
Kept as data rather than typed into the drafts, because the drafts are GENERATED:
editing galleryUrl in a draft by hand survives exactly until the next regeneration,
and then the link is silently gone from the LinkedIn post and the README that point
at it. phase2_gallery_drafts.py reads this file, so the URL outlives every rebuild.
